reason: My admin already types it all into Excel once a week. It's late, but it gets done and costs me nothing extra. Half my spending is cash to mechanics with no proper receipt anyway, so I might let it eat the free 30 out of curiosity, but I don't see myself paying monthly for something Excel or a bot I could build already does.
objection: Most of my money goes out as cash to mechanics and fuel with no clean receipt, so a bot that reads receipts misses the part that actually leaks. And $19 to $35 a month, every month, for what a free spreadsheet does is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it caught a duplicate or a padded mechanic bill and showed me cost per scooter without my admin touching it, I would pay $19.
